title: MPP payment methods: rail, author and intents
caption: The 11 method ids with spec files in tempoxyz/mpp-specs as of 2026-10-11, their rail, spec author and the intents each defines. Session exists only inside method specs. mpp.dev also documents monad and redotpay without spec files.
alt: Flowchart. Three intents: charge and subscription in specs/intents, session per method only. tempo (TIP-20, Tempo Labs) links to charge, session and subscription. stripe (SPT, Stripe and Tempo Labs) links to charge and subscription. card (network tokens, Visa) to charge. lightning (BOLT11, Lightspark) to charge and session. evm (Coinbase, MegaETH, Monad; OKG for session) to charge and session. solana to charge and session. stellar to charge. hedera to charge and session. usdc (Circle) to charge. nearintents (Near One) to charge. xrpl (Ripple) to charge and session.
